verdict.rationale: The first-party docs publish the CDP Facilitator fee schedule verbatim: the first 1,000 onchain transactions each month are free, each additional one costs $0.001, and payment verification is always free. They also explain that batch settlement lets one onchain transaction cover thousands of payments, so a merchant can price agentic channels from public docs without contacting sales. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the billed fees, and any stated breakdown of onchain network or gas costs and who bears them.
